name: Paris
description: The City of Light, famed for art, fashion, gastronomy, and culture with iconic landmarks like the Eiffel Tower and Louvre.

name: Rome
description: The Eternal City, home to nearly three millennia of globally influential art, architecture, and ruins like the Colosseum.

name: Tokyo
description: Japan's bustling capital, mixing ultramodern neon skyscrapers with historic temples and world-class culinary scenes.

name: Kyoto
description: Former imperial capital famous for numerous classical Buddhist temples, gardens, imperial palaces, and traditional wooden houses.

name: Barcelona
description: Cosmopolitan Mediterranean city known for its art and architecture, especially Gaudí's fantastical Sagrada Família.

name: London
description: Historic capital city featuring Big Ben, the London Eye, Buckingham Palace, and world-renowned West End theatre.

name: Amsterdam
description: Capital of the Netherlands, known for its artistic heritage, elaborate canal system, and narrow houses with gabled facades.

name: New York
description: The city that never sleeps, with iconic sights including Times Square, Central Park, Broadway, and the Statue of Liberty.

name: San Francisco
description: Famous for the Golden Gate Bridge, historic cable cars, colorful Victorian houses, and vibrant tech culture.

name: Bangkok
description: Thailand’s capital, large city known for ornate shrines, lively street food culture, and the bustling Chao Phraya River.

name: Bali (Denpasar)
description: Indonesian paradise island known for forested volcanic mountains, iconic rice paddies, beaches, and coral reefs.

name: Singapore
description: Global financial hub known for tropical climate, futuristic Gardens by the Bay, diverse food hawker centers, and Marina Bay.

name: Dubai
description: City of superlative architecture, luxury shopping, desert safaris, and the world's tallest building, Burj Khalifa.

name: Sydney
description: Australia's harbor city featuring the iconic Opera House, Harbour Bridge, Bondi Beach, and coastal walks.

name: Prague
description: The City of a Hundred Spires, known for its Old Town Square, colorful baroque buildings, Gothic churches, and Charles Bridge.

name: Vienna
description: Austria’s capital on the Danube river, shaped by its artistic and intellectual legacy including Mozart, Beethoven, and Freud.

name: Istanbul
description: Historic crossroads where Europe meets Asia, featuring the Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, and Bosphorus Strait.

name: Florence
description: Birthplace of the Renaissance, celebrated for its masterworks of art and architecture including the Duomo and Uffizi Gallery.

name: Venice
description: Built on more than 100 small islands in a lagoon, famous for gondola rides, St. Mark's Basilica, and Piazza San Marco.

name: Santorini
description: Cyclades island in the Aegean Sea, devastated by a 16th-century BC volcanic eruption, featuring white-washed cliffside villages.

name: Cairo
description: Egypt's sprawling capital along the Nile, home to the iconic Giza Pyramids and Great Sphinx dating back to the 26th century BC.

name: Rio de Janeiro
description: Huge seaside city famed for Copacabana and Ipanema beaches, Christ the Redeemer statue atop Mount Corcovado, and Sugarloaf Mountain.

name: Cape Town
description: Port city beneath towering Table Mountain, known for penguin colonies, dramatic coastal drives along Chapman's Peak, and wineries.

name: Zurich
description: Global hub for finance and banking, situated at the north end of Lake Zurich with picturesque medieval Altstadt and alpine scenery.

name: Reykjavik
description: Coastal capital known for geothermal Blue Lagoon spas, the Golden Circle route of geysers and waterfalls, and vibrant Northern Lights.
